preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients except bicarbonate, succinate, vitamins, cysteine
    and sulfide, then sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic.
    Add the bicarbonate and equilibrate the medium with the CO2 gas to reach a pH
    between 6.5 and 7.0. Dispense medium under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic
    Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Add succinate, vitamins, cysteine
    and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas. The
    vitamin solution should be sterilized by filtration. Prior to use adjust pH of
    complete medium to 6.6 - 6.8, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 50 mg haemin in 1 ml 1 N NaOH; make up to 100 ml with distilled
    water and filter sterilize. Store refrigerated.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients except bicarbonate, glucose, cysteine and sulfide.
    Sparge medium with 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic.
    Add and dissolve bicarbonate, then dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into
    anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Add glucose, cysteine
    and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas. Prior
    to use check pH of complete medium and adjust to 6.8 - 7.0, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve
    the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.
- step_number: 3
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: The ferrous sulfate solution is not stable and should be freshly prepared.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except carbonate, carbohydrates, cysteine and
    sulfide) and sparge medium with 100% CO2 gas for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic.
    Add the carbonate and equilibrate the medium with the CO2 gas to pH 6.8. Distribute
    under 100% CO2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and
    autoclave. Thereafter, add glucose, maltose, cellobiose, starch, cysteine and
    sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas. Cellobiose
    should be sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.7 - 6.8,
    if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or
    abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and
    then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum
    vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.
- step_number: 3
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 50 mg haemin in 1 ml 1 N NaOH; make up to 100 ml with distilled
    water and filter sterilize. Store refrigerated.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Use lean beef or horse meat. Remove fat and connective tissue before
    grinding. Mix meat, water and NaOH, then boil for 15 min with stirring. Cool to
    room temperature, skim fat off surface, and filter, retaining both meat particles
    and filtrate. To the filtrate add Casitone, yeast extract, hydrogen phosphate
    and resazurin, then add water to a final volume of 700 ml. Sparge medium with
    80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic, then add cysteine
    and adjust pH to 7.0. Dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type
    tubes containing meat particles (use ca. 7 ml liquid medium for 1 - 2 g meat particles),
    then autoclave at 121°C for 20 min. After autoclaving add fumarate, formate, rumen
    fluid, horse serum, fatty acids, vitamins, haemin, vitamin K1 and DTT rom sterile
    anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas atmosphere and sterilized by
    filtration.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or
    abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and
    then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum
    vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.
- step_number: 3
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH.
- step_number: 4
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 50 mg haemin in 1 ml 1 N NaOH; make up to 100 ml with distilled
    water and filter sterilize. Store refrigerated.
- step_number: 5
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 0.1 ml of vitamin K1 in 20 ml 95% ethanol and filter sterilize.
    Store refrigerated in a brown bottle.

  action: AUTOCLAVE

  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH solution.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: 'Mix components except NaHCO3 and bring to a boil for 5-10 sec. Cool
    down under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) and add NaHCO3 to the medium. Dispense
    the medium into culture vessels under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v), seal with
    butyl rubber stoppers and autoclave. Prior to inoculation, add per liter the following
    solutions (autoclaved and stored under a N2 atmosphere):'
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: Pressurize inoculated vessels to 200 kPa with a H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v)
    gas mixture.
- step_number: 3
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Add 0.4% yeast extract to sludge from an anaerobic digester, and after
    gassing with nitrogen gas for a few minutes incubate it at 37°C for 24 hours.
    Then centrifuge the sludge at 13000 g and autoclave the resulting, clear supernatant
    in screw-capped vessels under nitrogen gas. The sludge fluid can be stored at
    8-12°C in the dark.
- step_number: 4
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH solution.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Dissolve ingredients (except bicarbonate, vitamins, cysteine and sulfide)
    and sparge medium for 30 - 45 min with 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture to make
    it anoxic. Add and dissolve bicarbonate and adjust pH to 6.8, then distribute
    under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave.
    After sterilization add cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions
    autoclaved under 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Vitamins are prepared under 100% N2 gas
    atmosphere and sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.5.
    For incubation use sterile 80% H2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture at two atmospheres of
    pressure.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or
    abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and
    then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum
    vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.
- step_number: 3
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: First dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH,
    then add minerals. Adjust final to pH 7.0 with KOH.
- step_number: 4
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Add 10 ml rabbit serum, flush the medium with N2CO2, adjust the pH
    to 6.9 and filter-sterilize the completed medium into tubes.
- step_number: 2
  action: HEAT
  description: This recipe describes the preparation of 200 ml medium, which can be
    used for about 4 weeks when kept at 4°C.
- step_number: 3
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions A, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 4
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions B, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 5
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions C, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 6
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions D, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 7
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions E, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 8
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solution F, flush with nitrogen to make it anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at 4°C
- step_number: 9
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions G, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 10
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Solutions H, flush each with nitrogen to make them anoxic,
    filter-sterilize and store at -20°C
- step_number: 11
  action: HEAT
  description: Prepare Solution I and store at -20°C
- step_number: 12
  action: HEAT
  description: D,L-alpha-lipoic acid (1 mg/ml); in 2-mercaptoethanol-ethanol (1:10);
    store at -20°C
- step_number: 13
  action: MIX
  description: Hemin (0.2 mM) in NaOH (10 mM)
- step_number: 14
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Homogenize 42 g fresh baker yeast in 140 ml distilled water, incubate
    for 24h at 56°C and centrifuge to harvest the supernatant. Adjust pH to 7 with
    NaOH, make anoxic, filter-sterilize and store at -80°C
- step_number: 15
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Trace elements I, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic,
    filter-sterilize and store at 4°C
- step_number: 16
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Trace elements II, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic,
    filter-sterilize and store at 4°C
- step_number: 17
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Trace elements III, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic,
    filter-sterilize and store at 4°C
- step_number: 18
  action: MIX
  description: FeSO4 x 7H2O (10 mM) in HCl (10 mM)
- step_number: 19
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Supplements 1, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 20
  action: MIX
  description: Ascorbic acid (10%; w/v); in distilled water, neutralize with NaOH
- step_number: 21
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Supplements 2, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 22
  action: MIX
  description: Glutathion (0.5 M); in distilled water, neutralize with NaOH
- step_number: 23
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Prepare Supplements 3, flush with nitrogen to make them anoxic, filter-sterilize
    and store at -20°C
- step_number: 24
  action: HEAT
  description: Cholesterol (1 mg/ml); in Ethanol (100%); store at -20°C
- step_number: 25
  action: HEAT
  description: NaHCO3 (10%; w/v) in distilled water, store at 4°C

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix ingredients, except capronic acid, Trace vitamins, vitamin B12,
    NaHCO3, and Na2 x 9H2O, and autoclave under a N2-CO2 (4:1, v/v) atmosphere. Add
    capronic acid to 10 ml distilled water and adjust pH to 7.5 with NaOH. Filter-sterilize
    the capronic acid solution, Fatty acid mixture and Trace vitamins with vitamin
    B12, and store under a N2 atmosphere. Filter-sterilize 5% NaHCO3 solution and
    store under a N2-CO2 (4:1, v/v) atmosphere. Add the capronic acid solution, Fatty
    acid mixture, Trace vitamins and 5% NaHCO3 solution to the medium. Prior to inoculation,
    add a 5% Na2S x 9H2O solution (anaerobically autoclaved) to the medium. Adjust
    pH of the medium to 6.7 - 6.9, if necessary.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH solution.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix ingredients, except Na2S x 9H2O, and adjust pH to 6.5 with HCl.
    Distribute the medium into culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the medium in 120 ml
    serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (4:1, v/v) gas mixture and seal with butyl
    rubber stoppers, and autoclave. Neutralize Na2S x 9H2O as a 5% solution, and autoclave
    under a N2 atmosphere. Add the sterile Na2S solution to the medium, and pressurize
    the bottles to 200 kPa H2-CO2 (4:1, v/v). After incubation at 70C for 1 hr, readjust
    pH to 6.5 with a sterile and anaerobic NaHCO3 stock solution.
- step_number: 2
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid in 800 ml distilled water and adjust
    pH to 6.5 with NaOH. Then proceed to add the minerals and bring volume to 1.0
    L.
- step_number: 3
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 9.0 with NaOH.

- step_number: 1
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Add 0.45 ml Sol. B to 10 ml Sol. A. Inoculate and pressurize the tubes
    with H2 to 0.5 bar.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Boil for 5 min, cool to 50°C while gassing with 80% N2 + 20% CO2. Distribute
    to anaerobic tubes under the same atmosphere and autoclave.
- step_number: 3
  action: MIX
  description: Sterilize by filtration, add 20 ml rabbit serum, gas with 80% N2 +
    20% CO2.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Add and dissolve ingredients of solution A, adjust pH to 7.0, and sparge
    medium with 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic.
    Dispense medium under the same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes to
    30% of their volume and autoclave. Solution B is prepared under 80% N2 and 20%
    CO2 gas atmosphere and autoclaved. Solutions C, D, and H are autoclaved under
    a 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Solutions E, F, G, and I are prepared under 100% N2
    gas and sterilized by filtration. To complete the medium appropriate amounts of
    solutions B to I are added to the sterile solution A in the sequence as indicated.
- step_number: 2
  action: MIX
  description: 'Note: Some cultures are shipped in semi-solid medium which stimulates
    growth at the beginning. For agar stabs 3.00 g/l agar are added to the complete
    medium from a sterile anoxic stock solution (2% w/v). Upon receipt add anoxically
    1 - 2 ml of the recommended freshly prepared liquid medium to the agar tube and
    incubate for 3 - 5 days . After incubation transfer 0.5 ml of the resulting cell
    suspension in the liquid phase to tubes with liquid medium.'
- step_number: 3
  action: DISSOLVE
  description: First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve
    the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or
    abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and
    then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging
    with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum
    vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.
- step_number: 5
  action: FILTER_STERILIZE
  description: Dissolve 0.1 ml of vitamin K1 in 20 ml 95% ethanol and filter sterilize.
    Store refrigerated in a brown bottle.

Mix ingredients, except NaHCO3, L-cysteine·HCl·H2O and Na2S·9H2O, and adjust pH to 6.5. Bring to a boil for 5-10 sec, then, cool down under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) and add NaHCO3 to the medium. Dispense the medium into suitable culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the medium in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) and seal with butyl rubber stoppers. After autoclaving, stand the medium overnight. Separately autoclave cysteine·HCl and Na2S·9H2O as 5% solutions, respectively, under a N2 atmosphere. Prior to inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the L-cysteine·HCl·H2O and Na2S·9H2O solutions. Pressurize the inoculated bottles to 200 kPa H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v).
To prepare the clarified rumen fluid, preheat rumen content at 120C for 15 min. Use the supernatant after centrifuging at 25,000 x g for 15 min.
Fatty acid mixture:
Valeric acid  0.5     g
Isovaleric acid  0.5     g
α-Methylbutyric acid  0.5     g
Isobutyric acid  0.5     g
Distilled water  20.0     ml
Adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated NaOH solution.
